text.en:
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
ipality of Dulawan shall start from the western boundary
of Datu Piang's Katibpuan plantation at Nunañgan running
northward to BLM No. Six at the southern bank of the
Cotabato River.
Executive Order No. 82, dated August 18, 1917, is hereby
amended accordingly.
This order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 16th day of June; in
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred aüd jorty-nine,
and of the Independence of the Philippires, the third.
EUPIDIG QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
2391
By the Fresidert:
TrODORO EVANGELISTA
Executive Secretary
